title: Seedance Image Watermark Remover Workflow
description: Prepare and privately process an authorized Seedance image or extracted frame in JPG, PNG, or WebP format.
heading: Prepare Seedance images for private watermark processing
intro: Choose a supported still image, sign in with Google, upload directly to private R2 storage, and review the returned preview result.

process.heading: Prepare, upload, and review a Seedance still image

steps.title: Confirm the image format
steps.description: Use one JPG, PNG, or WebP still image between 1 byte and 10 MB.

steps.title: Send it through the private flow
steps.description: After Google sign-in, upload directly to private R2 storage without exposing storage credentials in the browser.

steps.title: Compare separate objects
steps.description: Open the temporary result and compare it with the untouched source object; the MVP result is currently an unchanged copy.

faq.heading: Seedance still-image formats, storage, and preview status

items.question: What size is supported?
items.answer: One image from 1 byte through 10 MB.

items.question: Is the original changed?
items.answer: No. The original remains a separate private object; the provider writes a separate result.

items.question: Is processing production-ready?
items.answer: No. The current provider returns an unchanged copy and is intended for workflow validation.
